fee_notes: Royalty 5% of Gross Rooms Revenue. World of Hyatt program assessment 4.5% of eligible revenue (or 2.25% when guest enrolled on-property). Commercial Services Fee 3.5% of Gross Rooms Revenue. Digital Acquisition Fee 1.35% of Gross Rooms Revenue through Digital Channels. GDS/reservation services ~$8.50/reservation avg. Mandatory contracts $1,500-$7,500/month. Other corporate services $500-$5,000/month.
